scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate checkout-blocker-by-talistech
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/checkout-blocker-by-talistech/tests/integration/safety.php && python3 tests/integration/checkout.py
scripts.i18n: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/checkout-blocker-by-talistech wp-content/plugins/checkout-blocker-by-talistech/languages/checkout-blocker-by-talistech.pot --exclude=vendor,node_modules,tests,dist,verification,bin,docs
scripts.check:plugin:source: wp-env run cli wp plugin check checkout-blocker-by-talistech --format=strict-json --exclude-directories=tests,dist,bin,docs,verification --exclude-files=.gitignore,.nvmrc,.wp-env.json,phpcs.xml.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,.phpunit.result.cache
